# Aidar Galimov

> Senior iOS developer and product manager with 8+ years of experience shipping consumer apps. Open to opportunities.

Key facts:
- Senior iOS Developer at Magic Unicorn Inc. (April 2019 — December 2024), where he spent over five years building Shapeyard — one of the most popular 3D modeling apps for iPhone and iPad with 1.3M+ users. Built its UIKit and SwiftUI interfaces, core business logic, StoreKit subscriptions, server integration, and caching.
- Previously iOS Developer / Project Manager at Junto (2017—2019), leading mobile teams of 5–10 people.
- Co-founded REVENT (2017—2019), a fashion resale marketplace: 20K+ downloads, ~5K registered users.
- Stack: Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency, Combine, StoreKit, RxSwift, Realm, Fastlane.
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, RANEPA (2015—2019).
- Contact: aidar.gf@gmail.com, Telegram @hiprozem.
